llm_proposer.assessment: The most likely cause is a failed WSS input port in the ROADM at S01. S01 is the sole element shared by every affected working path, and the simultaneous hard optical losses and protection switches are consistent with many channels being blocked there.

proposals.rationale: A WSS input-port failure at the common ROADM S01 can simultaneously block all channels arriving on that degree and account for the broad service outage, OCH_LOS alarms, and SNCP switches. Stable pump currents and unchanged measurements on numerous other spans and interfaces argue against an amplifier, fibre, or individual transponder failure.

A switch-fabric failure at the common site could interrupt many ODUs simultaneously. However, it should primarily produce ODU AIS and does not explain the widespread OCH_LOS and amplifier-input LOS indications, so it is much less likely.

proposals.rationale: A disconnected OMS input could directly cause AMP_INPUT_LOS on the S01-to-S04 line. A single connector cannot readily explain the simultaneous loss on the separate S01-to-S15 line and the full shared-service pattern, making this only a remote alternative.
